steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: AO6 Requirement: Use a range of vocabulary and sentence structures for clarity, purpose and effect, with accurate spelling and punctuation. Spelling errors can cost you marks across all writing questions. | Exceptions to remember: weird, seize, neither, either, foreign, height, their, heir | English Terms: metaphor, simile, personification, alliteration, onomatopoeia, juxtaposition, semantic field, foreshadowing, narrative, perspective | Tip: When in doubt, write the word down. Often your eye will catch an error that your brain misses.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Which is correct: "their book" or "there book"? | Spell the word meaning "to influence": affect or effect? | What is the correct spelling: neccessary or necessary?

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on AO6 Requirement, Exceptions to remember, English Terms, and one past-paper question.
